profile.name: Max Yankov
profile.headline: Product engineer for agent-related software
profile.summary: I build products around AI agents: the interfaces, tools, infrastructure, and safety systems that make them useful. My background spans full-stack and native engineering, developer tools, databases, games, and technical leadership.

themes.text: Remote full-stack product engineering for American startups.
The only founding engineer on an AI voice and messaging platform.
An independent graph-based knowledge system and its open-source foundations.
Conversational AI consulting for international clients.
Backend engineering for a competitive gaming platform.
Game and application development, from prototypes to live products.
Engineering leadership, hiring and development processes.
Game design and production: mechanics, economies, live content and art coordination.
Founded and launched an adtech startup, raising seed investment and attracting its first advertisers.

work.summary: My own graph-based knowledge system: a production product that turns messy company communication into a live, cited model of what is true and how the business works. I’m finishing it through open-source work on its underlying tools and infrastructure.

highlights.text: Designed a temporal knowledge graph of natural-language entities, rules, procedures, typed relationships, and effective time windows—not isolated chat history or flat document retrieval.
Made facts atomic, source-cited, and fully traceable to who said them, when they became true, and what they superseded.
Built contradiction detection and proactive interception of outdated claims, preserving both old and current facts and the reason one replaced another.

Built ingestion for Telegram, email, Google Docs and Sheets, Notion, Trello, web pages, PDFs, git, YouGile, GetCourse, and Shopify inboxes, with versioned source identities, sections, chunks, fingerprints, and reingestion.

emphases.text: ingestion for Telegram, email, Google Docs and Sheets, Notion, Trello, web pages, PDFs, git, YouGile, GetCourse, and Shopify inboxes
versioned source identities, sections, chunks, fingerprints, and reingestion

highlights.text: Implemented lexical and embedding retrieval, graph-neighbor expansion, temporal filtering, citation-aware answers, and a managed pgvector/IVFFlat embedding lifecycle.

emphases.text: lexical and embedding retrieval, graph-neighbor expansion, temporal filtering, citation-aware answers

highlights.text: Created extraction and graph-review workflows for entity discovery, deduplication, link and citation coverage, recategorization, splitting, hierarchy, assumptions, provenance chains, orphan rules, and hub organization.

emphases.text: entity discovery, deduplication, link and citation coverage, recategorization, splitting, hierarchy, assumptions, provenance chains, orphan rules, and hub organization

highlights.text: Built a custom durable scheduler and agent-workflow runtime with claimed work items, retries, backoff, crash recovery, provider and token budgets, scheduled and one-off execution, and immutable audit history.

emphases.text: custom durable scheduler and agent-workflow runtime
claimed work items, retries, backoff, crash recovery

highlights.text: Added versioned process contracts that let agents realize business procedures, bind trusted outputs, record required tool calls, and gate external effects behind explicit authority and approval.

emphases.text: gate external effects behind explicit authority and approval

highlights.text: Built per-source and per-fact access control with roles, scoped labels, provenance-propagated permissions, PostgreSQL row-level security, and hard failure for uncited or blocked knowledge.
Used advanced PostgreSQL throughout the product: recursive CTEs, triggers, stored functions, row-level security, carefully designed indexes, query-plan analysis, and performance-sensitive SQL.
Delivered multi-tenant knowledge bases with tenant-safe foreign keys, per-KB configuration, language and domain context, isolated credentials, bots, data, and model-provider routes.

Shipped cited Q&A and operational interfaces through per-company Telegram bots, a web knowledge browser, a large CLI/tool surface, APIs, inline search, group-safe behavior, and desktop/mobile login flows.
highlights.emphasis: Telegram bots, a web knowledge browser, a large CLI/tool surface, APIs

highlights.text: Built the frontend in Preact and TypeScript with Vite, ECharts, Storybook, Playwright, responsive app views, and reusable light/dark UI primitives.
Operated a Python backend using PostgreSQL, pgvector, psycopg, FastAPI/Starlette, and Pydantic AI.
Integrated OpenAI and other commercial model APIs, routed Claude Code to OpenAI-compatible providers through a self-hosted LiteLLM gateway, and hosted and tuned private OpenLLaMA inference with vLLM.

emphases.text: OpenAI and other commercial model APIs
hosted and tuned private OpenLLaMA inference with vLLM

highlights.text: Deployed on Hetzner with Docker, Caddy, blue-green releases, k3s/Kubernetes workloads, private model services, zero-downtime routing, S3-compatible storage, restore-tested backups, and production smoke tests.

emphases.text: Hetzner with Docker, Caddy, blue-green releases
restore-tested backups, and production smoke tests

highlights.text: Built custom production observability infrastructure around workflow and agent-run histories, host metrics, provider usage, operator diagnostics, alerts, Sentry, Better Stack, and Braintrust trace archives.

emphases.text: host metrics, provider usage, operator diagnostics, alerts, Sentry

highlights.text: Built cost-directed model evaluation with controlled cohorts, hidden-gold case banks, reasoning evidence, failure triage, and promotion gates.
As founder, built the production system solo in roughly five months using a fleet of coding agents and an automated merge-test-deploy loop.

Turned that development machinery into Coloph Sync, an open-source coordinator for reviewed commits, isolated worktrees, integration checks, resilient deployment, recovery, and evidence-backed delivery state.

emphases.text: open-source coordinator for reviewed commits, isolated worktrees, integration checks

highlights.text: Used by several real clients. One production knowledge base processed about 3,200 conversations and documents and 7M source tokens into about 5,000 facts and entities with 8,000 citations.
Separately stress-tested ingestion on about 334,000 emails and 150M source tokens, plus a large public engineering handbook.
Extracted reusable open-source foundations into Coloph Works: migrations, environment handling, skills, command safety, sync coordination, and delivery across Git worktrees.

emphases.text: sync coordination, and delivery across Git worktrees
